principles: Track reproducible code, not bulky generated data.
Make the experiment code auditable via the review gate.
Keep the product repo clean (data lives with the paper).
drivers: Auditability of the section-6 experiment code
Avoid dumping experiment output into the product repo

options.name: code-only-onboard
cons: Old run-records not in this repo (they are in the paper repo)

options.name: code-plus-data-onboard
cons: Dumps 14 bulky .jsonl data files into the product repo

options.name: leave-as-scratch
cons: Experiment code stays ungated/unauditable, inconsistent with the trust-the-gate thesis

rationale: Tracking the code (plus a README pointing to the paper repo for data) makes the harness auditable and reproducible without polluting the product repo with generated .jsonl run-records.

preMortem.trigger: git add experiments/recovery-runner/ globs in the .jsonl
preMortem.consequence: Bulky data dumped into the product repo
preMortem.mitigation: Add only the explicit non-jsonl code files; verify git ls-files shows no .jsonl

preMortem.trigger: A reference-solution does not actually pass its own acceptance/ground-truth
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-005 runs each reference-solution against acceptance + ground-truth before DONE

preMortem.scenario: Verification triggers the expensive LLM loop
preMortem.mitigation: Verify fixture self-consistency only (reference vs acceptance/ground-truth), never the live loop
